# we unfold — Open Intelligence

> Home of the Open Intelligence movement and its economic dimension, Open Economy. This is a preview: the manifesto is Draft 0.12 (2026-10-25), proposed for review, and nothing here has been launched or approved.

Every figure on the site carries its state: Proposal, Example, Not measured yet, or Sample data. There are no live member counts, funding totals or votes. Proposed initiatives and their terms are proposals, not offers.

## Manifesto

- [Manifesto and charter (Markdown)](manifesto.md): the full text, Draft 0.12. SHA-256 `25583653ab507d892f096d87ebce6014f1ade65206a79aac76eb1cf0e61cba15`, not anchored yet.
- [Manifesto and charter (plain page)](manifesto.html): the same text as an accessible HTML page with a contents list.
- [Everything in one file](llms-full.txt): the manifesto and charter in a single Markdown file.

## Optional

- [The experience](./): the scroll-driven page. It needs WebGL. Its scenes quote the manifesto and add previews (Open Economy, participants, Proof of Progress) that are not in the files above.
